title: 第89章 林美玲上门借钱

第89章 林美玲上门借钱-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强站在旁边，看着窗外的县城街道。

傍晚了，下班的人骑着自行车回家，车铃铛叮铃铃响。

卖馒头的小贩推着车沿街叫卖，声音悠长。

刘强写完欠条，签了名，按了手印，递给林国强。

林国强接过来看了看，折好，收进兜里。

“刘哥，嫂子那边你别操心。

我让素梅过去开解，陪她说说话。”

刘强点了点头，没说话。

他转过身，面朝窗户，肩膀微微发抖。

林国强拍了拍他的肩膀，转身走了。

回镇上的路上，天已经黑了。

自行车前灯昏黄，照在土路上，坑坑洼洼的。

林国强一边蹬车一边想事情。

刘强是个清官。

在派出所所长的位置上，想弄钱太容易了。

集市的摊位费、商户的孝敬、各种罚款的油水，稍微松松手，一个月多几十块进项不难。

但刘强没有。

他家的陈设，他媳妇的药费，他连两百块都贷不出来的窘迫，都说明这个人干干净净。

这样的人，值得帮。

但光靠借钱不是长久之计。

周红有病，不能断药，不能受刺激，不能累着。

两个孩子上学，开销一年比一年大。

刘强那点工资，永远不够。

得想个办法，让刘强家有个稳稳当当的进项，还得是周红能干的、不费神不操心的那种。

林国强一边蹬车一边琢磨。

夜色里，自行车轮碾过砂石路，发出沙沙的声响。

刘建良手术后第十天，出了院，回家养着。

刘强把欠林国强的三百块钱还了一百，说剩下的分期还。

林国强收了一百，把欠条拿出来，改了个数。

刘强看着改过的欠条，叹了口气：“国强，我这辈子欠你的，怕是还不清了。”

“还不清就慢慢还。”

林国强给他倒了杯茶，“刘哥，我跟你说个事。”

刘强抬起头。

“嫂子现在病情稳定了，但天天在家闷着也不是个事。

大夫也说了，这病得养，但不能跟社会脱节。

人闷久了，容易胡思乱想，得给她找点事干。

不累的，不操心的，不用跟太多人打交道的。”

刘强苦笑：“我也想过，但她这情况，哪有这种活儿？”

“有。”

Lin Guoqiang stood aside, looking out the window at the county streets.

In the evening, people after get off work ride their bicycles home, their bells jingling.

The steamed bun vendor pushed his cart and hawked his goods along the street with a long voice.

Liu Qiang finished writing the IOU, signed it, pressed his fingerprints, and handed it to Lin Guoqiang.

Lin Guoqiang took it, looked at it, folded it, and put it in his pocket.

"Brother Liu, don't worry about my sister-in-law.

I asked Sumei to go over and talk to her."

Liu Qiang nodded and said nothing.

He turned around and faced the window, his shoulders shaking slightly.

Lin Guoqiang patted his shoulder, turned and left.

On the way back to town, it was already dark.

The bicycle headlights dimly shine on the dirt road, which is full of potholes.

Lin Guoqiang was thinking about things while pedaling.

Liu Qiang is an upright official.

In the position of police station director, it is too easy to make money.

The stall fees at the market, the contribution of merchants, and various fines are all part of it. If you relax a little, it is not difficult to make an income of dozens of yuan a month.

But Liu Qiang didn't.

The furnishings of his house, the money for his wife's medicine, and his embarrassment that he couldn't even borrow two hundred yuan, all showed that this man was clean.

Such people are worth helping.

But borrowing money alone is not a long-term solution.

Zhou Hong is sick and cannot stop taking medicine, cannot be stimulated, and cannot be tired.

The cost of sending two children to school is getting higher and higher every year.

Liu Qiang's salary is never enough.

We have to find a way to make Liu Qiang's family have a steady income, and it has to be the kind that Zhou Hong can do without any effort or worry.

Lin Guoqiang pondered while pedaling.

In the night, the bicycle wheels made a rustling sound as they rolled over the gravel road.

On the tenth day after the operation, Liu Jianliang was discharged from the hospital and returned home to recuperate.

Liu Qiang paid back 100 yuan of the 300 yuan he owed Lin Guoqiang and said he would pay the rest in installments.

Lin Guoqiang collected one hundred, took out the IOU, and changed the number.

Liu Qiang looked at the revised IOU and sighed: "Guo Qiang, I'm afraid I won't be able to repay what I owe you in this life."

"If you still can't pay it back, pay it back slowly."

Lin Guoqiang poured him a cup of tea, "Brother Liu, let me tell you something."

Liu Qiang raised his head.

“My sister-in-law’s condition is now stable, but it’s not a problem to be bored at home every day.

The doctor also said that the disease can be treated, but it cannot be disconnected from society.

When people are bored for a long time, they tend to have random thoughts, so you need to find something for her to do.

Not tired, not worried, not having to deal with too many people."

Liu Qiang smiled bitterly: "I have thought about it too, but in her situation, how can she have such a job?"

"Yes."
